jobs.occupation: (Senior) Transaction Analyst Real Estate (m/f/d), Top Tegel (Wertpapieranalyst/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for an (Senior) Analyst to join our Transactions Team in Berlin. In this hands-on investment role, you will support acquisitions, disposals, and joint ventures across office, hotel, residential/BTR, logistics, and development assets. Working closely with Senior Transaction Managers and the Co-Head of Transactions, you will be involved in underwriting, financial modelling, due diligence, transaction execution, and investment analysis across Germany and selected international markets. Location: Berlin Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel, residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment scenarios. Drafting or assisting with drafting and review Letters of Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents. Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis & Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models (excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth feasibility analysis for repositioning, conversion, and development scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive market research on target real estate sub-markets, including supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education & Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets; experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR analysis, and scenario modelling -- proficiency is non-negotiable. Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering) and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage. Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks, Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong quantitative and analytical thinking -- able to cut through complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- ability to present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for professional development and accelerated career progression within a large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail, and development. Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Very good IT infrastructure with access to leading AI tools Good atmosphere, communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training for professional and personal development in our academy Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and classes Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme Mobility and flexibility using pool and company cars for the execution of tasks Exciting virtual programs for childcare with our partner company Voiio Discounts at selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on overnight stays and special conditions on food and beverages Additional days off on Christmas eve & New years eve Have we sparked your interest?  Then click on "Apply now" and Max Boikov will be happy to receive your application documents, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations. Aroundtown, Personalabteilung, Wittestraße 30, Haus F, 13509 Berlin

jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry team and help shape the future of laboratory automation in drug discovery. We are looking for a passionate and innovative Senior Automation Scientist to drive the scientific, technological, and strategic development of our cutting-edge automation capabilities. As a Senior Automation Scientist, you will design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for synthesis, purification, and analysis. You will collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, and IT teams to orchestrate multi-instrument systems and develop robust processes across leading liquid- and solid-handling and analytical platforms. You will play a key role in advancing innovative solutions that continuously improve the efficiency of in-house workflows.Ready to make an impact with automation-driven science? Apply now and help transform the future of drug discovery.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will design, implement, and maintain orchestration workflows for integrated automation platforms, including scheduler-driven systems, coordinating robotic systems, liquid and solid handlers, analytical instruments, and data systems, covering the entire MAKE cycle from synthesis planning to compound registration.- Your expertise in laboratory automation enables you to design end-to-end data flow concepts and define the requirements for digital interfaces between automation systems and enterprise data platforms (e.g., ELN, LIMS, data lakes, APIs), ensuring seamless and scalable management of experimental data.- You will shape the future automation landscape by designing process architectures, defining system and integration requirements, and guiding the development of scalable orchestration concepts for data-driven laboratory workflows.- You will collaborate closely with chemists, engineers, data scientists, IT and cross-functional teams to translate research challenges into physical prototypes, automated workflows, communicate automation outputs effectively, and translate predictive insights into actionable synthesis and experimental recommendations.- Moreover, you will continuously monitor scientific literature and emerging methods in laboratory automation, physical prototyping, orchestration platforms, liquid handling, analytical instruments and digital lab integration, incorporating state-of-the-art approaches into our automation and data infrastructure to maintain a leading-edge capability.Requirements- Master's degree in chemistry or related field with > 5 years of experience in laboratory automation, robotics or engineering, and basic knowledge of synthetic organic chemistry.- Hands-on expertise in liquid handler programming, lab orchestration and scripting spanning multiple major platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, BioNex, Opentrons)- Proficiency in modern programming/scripting languages, particularly Python; experience with system integration, APIs, and data interfaces in laboratory environments- Understanding of drug discovery workflows and laboratory processes; strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in complex automation systems- Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams- Fluent English language skills, both written and Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. Contract We are looking forward to your application via our online-portal https://karriere.frm2.tum.de until  26.11.2026.  Here you may also find other job vacancies at FRM II: https://karriere.frm2.tum.de   Technische Universität München Forschungsneutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) Personalbüro Lichtenbergstraße 1 D-85748 Garching Tel: +49 89 289 12305 oder 14910    www.mlz-garching.de www.frm2.tum.de   As part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.my-tum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and under-stood the data protection information (https://www.tum.de/spezialseiten/datenschutz/) provided by TUM.
